sql.dataType.getCompanyDataTypes: select cdt.id, cdt.company_id, cdt.company_data_type, cdt.data_type_id, cdt.has_list_values, cdt.archived, dt.data_type from flow.company_data_type cdt inner join flow.data_type dt on dt.id = cdt.data_type_id where cdt.company_id = :companyId and cdt.archived is not true
